title: Resistance force calculation
description: Essential: Correctly calculates resistance force using f = P/v_max with proper unit conversion from km/h to m/s.

title: Traction force determination
description: Important: Applies Newton's second law (F - f = ma) to find traction force during acceleration.

title: Maximum velocity during acceleration
description: Important: Recognizes that during acceleration, power limits velocity via v = P/F before uniform motion begins.

title: Displacement calculation
description: Important: Correctly uses kinematic equations (v² = 2ax) to find distance traveled during acceleration.

title: Work done by resistance
description: Essential: Calculates work as W = -f·x with correct sign indicating negative work.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent SI units throughout all calculations (kW→W, km/h→m/s).

title: Sign error in work
description: Pitfall: Fails to include negative sign for work done by resistance force (opposite to displacement).

title: Power misconception
description: Pitfall: Assumes maximum power is delivered throughout acceleration rather than using P = F·v.
